events.game: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (PC digital)
events.what_removed: The whole game, temporarily pulled from digital PC stores; the trigger was reported to be Michael Jackson's "Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'", with Sony Music as claimant (unconfirmed)
events.why_reported: Rockstar statement: "Due to some music licensing issues, we've had to temporarily remove Vice City PC from digital stores."

events.game: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (PC digital re-release incl. Steam; mobile 10th anniversary release)
events.what_removed: Billie Jean and Wanna Be Startin' Somethin' (Michael Jackson), Bark at the Moon (Ozzy Osbourne), Wow (Kate Bush), Rockit (Herbie Hancock), Looking for the Perfect Beat (Afrika Bambaataa), Running with the Night (Lionel Richie), plus "a couple of songs from Radio Espantoso" (fan-compiled list)
events.why_reported: Music licensing (follows Rockstar's November 2012 licensing statement)

events.game: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas (Steam PC update; matches mobile and Xbox 360 HD versions)
events.what_removed: 17 licensed songs (plus high-resolution options); same 17 already absent from the mobile version and the Xbox 360 HD port of it
events.why_reported: Expired song licences, by press accounts; Rockstar made no statement

events.game: Grand Theft Auto IV and Episodes from Liberty City
events.what_removed: Tracks across 10 stations; Vladivostok FM hit hardest (15 tracks), also Liberty Rock Radio, The Journey, Vice City FM and others; 11 replacements added to Vladivostok FM
events.count: 43 listed by Game Informer; Destructoid counts 51, including Episodes tracks and one unused track
events.why_reported: The original ten-year licences ran out; Rockstar had confirmed beforehand that some songs would go
Unverified. One press report calls it the first song GTA V lost, in 2018; fans date the removal to the Los Santos Tuners update (2021)

events.game: Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition (Vice City and San Andreas)
events.what_removed: Launch track list missing 20 Vice City and 18 San Andreas songs, including Billie Jean and Wanna Be Startin' Somethin' (Michael Jackson), Killing in the Name (Rage Against the Machine) and Express Yourself (N.W.A.); later in November 2021 Rockstar sent an amended list with "a number of tracks reinstated", naming none
events.count: 38 at first report; how many stayed missing after the amended list is not public
events.why_reported: Rockstar confirmed some music would be missing; dataminers said the PC version "contains all the music that's no longer licensed"

events.game: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced (PC; consoles expected)
events.what_removed: Moloko, "The Time Is Now" (2000), from Non-Stop-Pop FM, via hotfix spotted by dataminers
events.why_reported: No Rockstar statement; press calls an expired, unrenewed licence the likely explanation

source.publication: GTA BOOM (Ray Ampoloquio, updated 2026-09-17 by Matt Gibbs)
